texts: Donkey is a small shop with a big shelf: everyday things for the kitchen, the garden and a slow weekend, chosen by hand and priced plainly.
Four kinds of thing, all chosen by hand.
We keep the shelf short on purpose. Each thing earns its place: it lasts, it does one job well, and it costs what it says.
Mugs, bowls, and the small tools we reach for daily.
Pots, twine and gloves that survive a wet spring.
Blankets, lanterns and things for slow days off.
Wrapped, stamped and ready for someone else.
We started Donkey because buying a good wooden spoon shouldn't take an afternoon. So we do the looking for you: we hold each thing, use it for a week, and only then does it go on the shelf.
with no faff around them. When something sells out, we say so and tell you when it's back, rather than quietly taking your order.
Orders go out from our own little store room. If you're not sure which size or shape you need, write to us and a real person will answer.
Ready to have a look around?
Sign up to step into the shop, or read how buying works first. Either way, take your time.
Plain, useful things for the home and the garden, chosen by Donkey and sent out from our workshop.
Donkey, a small shop for everyday things.
